personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (adapted for ChatGPT × Apple minimalist dark-charcoal & off-white restraint)
personality_one_liner: Calm, expensive-because-restrained rental operating system with pristine typography, generous whitespace, and zero dashboard clutter.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room with 16pt outer paddings, 12pt card gaps, and 56pt minimum interactive touch targets.

do's: Use solid dark charcoal surfaces (#121214 / #1A1A1E) with subtle 1px structural borders (#27272A)
Rely on exquisite typography hierarchy and whitespace instead of heavy shadows or glass blurs
dont's: No glassmorphism everywhere, no neon glows, no crypto or SaaS dashboard overload
No gradient text or rainbow accent fills

screens.name: Hari Ini
screens.purpose: Answers 'APA YANG PERLU GUE BERESIN HARI INI?' with actionable queue cards for follow-ups, viewings, unpaid rent, and maintenance.

states.loading: Centered minimalist spinner with muted status subtitle
states.empty: Clean illustration + 'Semua beres hari ini. Santai dulu.' + Primary CTA to check leads
states.error: Readable error banner with retry button

screens.layout: Sticky header with logo and live units badge, followed by summary metric strip, priority action queue with swipeable beresin cards, and quick AI import trigger.

screens.name: Unit
screens.purpose: Manages unit portfolio (kos, apartment, villa, kontrakan) across statuses with quick occupancy filters and AI matching.

states.loading: Skeleton card pulse in dark charcoal
states.empty: Empty unit illustration + 'Belum ada unit terdaftar' + Add Unit CTA
states.error: Connection error state with reload action

screens.layout: Segmented status filter chips (Semua, Terisi, Kosong, Perbaikan), vertical stack of unit cards with occupancy tags, rent pricing, and 'Cari Penyewa AI' action.

screens.name: Calon Penyewa
screens.purpose: Tracks prospective tenants extracted from WhatsApp chats with stage Kanban and AI lead scoring.

states.empty: No leads illustration + 'Belum ada calon penyewa' + WhatsApp Chat Import CTA

screens.layout: Horizontal stage filter pills (Baru, Ngobrol, Viewing, Deal), WhatsApp Chat Paste/Upload banner at top, and list of rich lead cards with match score and draft follow-up.

screens.name: Tenant
screens.purpose: Manages active tenants, lease dates, and rent payment tracking with one-tap WhatsApp reminders.

states.empty: No active tenants message + Add lease CTA

screens.layout: Payment status summary header (Sudah Bayar / Belum Bayar), tenant list with unit number, due date badge, and quick action buttons for payment confirmation and reminder.

screens.name: Masalah
screens.purpose: Tracks property maintenance and tenant complaints with AI classification (priority, category, estimated cost).

states.empty: All clear illustration + 'Tidak ada masalah aktif' + Log issue button

screens.layout: Priority filter tabs (Darurat, Sedang, Selesai), ticket list cards featuring unit badge, AI priority tag, description, and status toggle.

screens.name: Tanya Sewain & Impact
screens.purpose: AI assistant querying live property database and Impact analytics showing honest operational metrics and before/after time saved.

states.loading: Initializing AI assistant and metrics computation
states.empty: Start conversation prompt with quick suggested questions
states.error: AI query timeout error with retry

screens.layout: Tabbed secondary view featuring AI chat message thread with quick prompt chips, followed by Impact metrics cards (jam admin dihemat, unit occupancy rate, cashflow collection speed).

hero_banner.alt: Modern Indonesian villa interior dark moody

instructions_to_main_agent: Build Sewain as a world-class React Native mobile app with bottom navigation and responsive web sidebar layout.
Strictly follow the ChatGPT x Apple visual direction: charcoal (#121214) base, off-white (#FAFAFA) text, muted zinc borders (#27272A), zero neon, zero glassmorphism overload.
Every screen must feature loading, empty, and error states following the prompt requirements.
Implement WhatsApp chat import AI parser flow for leads extraction (.txt / paste simulation with staged extraction).
Home screen answers 'APA YANG PERLU GUE BERESIN HARI INI?' with swipeable action cards ('Beresin satu-satu').
All Indonesian UI copy must be natural and user-focused ('Calon penyewa', 'Perlu follow-up', 'Belum bayar', 'Tanya Sewain').
Ensure touch targets are >= 44x44pt and safe area is respected at all screen roots.
